findings.gap: New transactions/transaction/staged/backups directory links and journal pathname are created without fsyncing their parent directories before W-side durable renames. Fsync of journal data or child directory contents does not itself establish parent-link durability. No crash execution was performed.
findings.requested_correction: Fsync recovery namespace parent directories, including the journal directory link, before any W mutation.

findings.gap: Only a directory named by raw authorization SHA excludes a repeated same-serialization run. Equivalent valid root authorization objects can serialize differently, yield distinct hashes and transaction dirs, and overlap this mechanism.
findings.requested_correction: One fixed owned active-install protocol lock, held throughout and preserved on partial failure, separate from .git/index.lock. No claim of hostile global W concurrency isolation required.

findings.gap: Each disk buffer is staged and published inside one loop; a later staging failure can occur after earlier W mutations. All19in-memory buffers are already authenticated; this is not an authentication omission.
findings.requested_correction: Prepare/fsync/verify all19disk buffers before any W target or new article directory mutation.

partial_failure_policy.supported_policy: Stop and preserve durable intent/completion/partial evidence for manual root recovery; no automatic rollback.
partial_failure_policy.example: Failure after parking the first old aggregate (step17) but before publishing its replacement leaves16newfiles present, that aggregate absent and original parked in the transaction. Both ordinary preflight and successful-postinstall guard should then refuse. Recovery is manual, not safe rerun of install.
partial_failure_policy.not_automatic_defect: Lack of automatic rollback alone is not a defect under the allowed honest partial-recovery route. Recovery infrastructure must first be durable and transaction-excluded.
partial_failure_policy.later_backups: Keep originals near their replacements rather than parking all3first, as root requested.

root_requested_revision: Durable parent links; fixed owned active mechanism lock preserved on partial failure; all19disk buffers prepared first;16new first/3replacements last; explicit stop/preserve/manual recovery. No W or install authority granted.
